summary.note: Informational projection of the contract and receipt; only the statement and manifest are cryptographically bound.
summary.objective: Stop readMaintenanceOwner from reporting E_STORAGE_MAINTENANCE_OWNER_INVALID when owner.json is atomically replaced (rename) between its lstat and open: re-read, with every safety check, a bounded number of times when a fresh lstat shows a different regular in-root file, so a losing concurrent resumer sees the winner's owner and gets E_STORAGE_MAINTENANCE_IN_PROGRESS. Reproduced 1 in 80-100 runs of the two-resumer test under load (stack: filesystem.js:115 via maintenance.js:287).
successCriteria: A deterministic test replaces owner.json between lstat and open: before the fix it fails with OWNER_INVALID, after it returns the new owner
A symlink or out-of-root swap still fails with OWNER_INVALID
